info.title: Quiz Master API
info.description:
REST API for the Bangladesh competitive examination preparation platform (BCS, bank, NTRCA, admission and more).

**Clients:** Kotlin Android student app and Next.js administration dashboard.

**Envelope:** every JSON response is `{ success, data, meta }`; errors are `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details }, meta }`.
Clients should switch on `error.code` (stable) rather than `message` (human readable).

**Route groups:** `/api/v1/public/*` (no auth), `/api/v1/*` (authenticated student), `/api/v1/admin/*` (staff with permissions).

**Auth:** short-lived bearer access tokens + rotating opaque refresh tokens (`POST /auth/refresh`).

identifier.description: Bangladeshi mobile number (01XXXXXXXXX / +8801XXXXXXXXX) or email address.

currentPassword.description: Required when the account already has a password.

code.description: DELETE_ACCOUNT one-time code sent to the account's phone/email.

eligibility.description: Structured eligibility (age limits, education, quota) taken from the official circular.

isOfficial.description: Must only be true when copied from the recruiting authority's own publication.

copyFromVersionId.description: Copy topic mappings from an existing version (new circulars usually change only a few topics).

weight.description: Relative priority 0..1 used by the adaptive engine.

replace.description: When true, mappings not listed are removed.

submitForReview.description: Submit imported questions straight to review instead of leaving them as drafts.

passageId.description: Passage-based questions share a stem passage.

isDemo.description: Demonstration content (seed/sample data). Never presented as an official paper.

content.description: New content creates a new version (or replaces an unpublished draft).

paperId.description: PAPER mode: practise a published previous-year paper in its original order.

instantFeedback.description: Show correctness + explanation right after each answer (default true).

unlocked.description: False when a premium entitlement is required
False when a premium entitlement is required

questionTypes.description: Restrict the pool to these question types (default: all auto-graded types).

questionIds.description: FIXED sections: exact question ids (pinned to their published version on publish).

availableFrom.description: Live/scheduled exams: attempts may start only inside this window.

config.description: Edits the draft only; students see changes after the next publish (existing attempts keep their rules).

serverTime.description: Authoritative server time; clients must derive the countdown from this, not the device clock

timeSpentMs.description: Client-measured time spent on this question since the last save (ms). Capped server-side.
Client-measured time spent on this question since the last save (ms). Capped server-side.

studyDays.description: Days of week (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday) the student studies.

isPublic.description: Staff only: publish as a system card visible to every student.

isAuthoritative.description: e.g. official syllabus or circular copied from the authority's website.

redirectUrl.description: Open this URL to complete payment (PENDING only)

amountMinor.description: Omit for a full refund of the remaining amount.

keepAccess.description: Keep the purchased access after a full refund (goodwill).

sourceReference.description: Where the paper came from (publication, archive reference).

submitForReview.description: Default true: imported questions enter the review queue.
